title: Pretext main branch SSR bundle lacks amplify_outputs.json (front page 500)
description: Root cause: the cms-production build spec wrote amplify_outputs.json only at the checkout root; the SSR compute bundle lacks it, so getLatestPublishedEdition threw. Fixed in Papyrus#156 (merge f0c0ee3, release 1.0.0-next.22): Pretext production spec copies it to .next/ and sets PAPYRUS_AMPLIFY_OUTPUTS. TI PR AnthusAI/Threat-Intelligence#12 picks it up.

comments.author: home
comments.text: P4-06 FOLLOW-UP (2026-10-07 UTC, ryan-authorized, dzefa11i80jyq only). 20:12Z cdk diff vs live stack: only app buildSpec (adds `cp amplify_outputs.json .next/amplify_outputs.json` and `echo PAPYRUS_AMPLIFY_OUTPUTS=.next/amplify_outputs.json >> .env.production`) and Branch PAPYRUS_OAUTH_REDIRECT_URLS (adds default-URL entries); no replace/delete. Deployed 20:15:09Z (17s). get-app: WEB_COMPUTE, service/compute roles unchanged, repository https://github.com/anthusai/threat-intelligence kept, main has 12 env names. Job 5 RELEASE 20:15:43Z-20:24:39Z SUCCEED; build log shows both new lines executed. RESULT: `/` STILL 500, /newsroom 200. CloudWatch: same `Papyrus requires amplify_outputs.json` from getLatestPublishedEdition. Likely cause: the echo of PAPYRUS_AMPLIFY_OUTPUTS runs AFTER `npm run build`, so the var is not in the runtime env (lib/amplify-outputs-path.ts reads process.env.PAPYRUS_AMPLIFY_OUTPUTS, else cwd/amplify_outputs.json). Probably the echo must precede the build. Needs a template fix. Old app d3on1y5vlrxmam untouched (job 71, auto-build false, site 200); Cognito callbacks include default-URL entries.

comments.author: home
comments.text: home: PPY-4243f7 attempt (2026-10-07 UTC). Cause found by experiment, not the suspected order: Papyrus#159 (next.25) put `PAPYRUS_AMPLIFY_OUTPUTS` in `.env.production` BEFORE `npm run build`; TI job 6 (20:48Z) then FAILED in `next build` page-data collection with `Papyrus requires amplify_outputs.json` (the build reads .next/amplify_outputs.json before the post-build cp creates it). So env-before-build is wrong; env-after-build (#156) leaves the runtime without the file. Fix Papyrus#161 (merged c4f3e28, release 1.0.0-next.27 / PyPI dev27): spec drops the env line (copy into .next stays after build); lib/amplify-outputs-path falls back to cwd/.next/amplify_outputs.json; unit test + synth order assertions. WARNING: develop at next.25/next.26 has the broken #159 spec; use next.27. Deployed to dzefa11i80jyq (domain-free copy, cdk diff = buildSpec only, 21:16:42-21:17:03Z). Job 7 RELEASE 21:17:05Z-21:25:47Z SUCCEED. HTTP: / still 500, /newsroom 200, because the app package pin in TI main is still next.22 so the runtime lib lacks the fallback. Pin-bump PR AnthusAI/Threat-Intelligence#13 (package.json, lock, infra/site.json to next.27) NOT merged: merging it (autoBuild true) builds and should fix /. Old app d3on1y5vlrxmam untouched: job 71, autoBuild false, live site 200. Ticket NOT closed.
